formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x3)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = (x3 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x3 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 = fun (x4 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => [((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ))), ((8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))].any fun (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) × Fin (9 : ℕ)) => x4 x5.1 && x4 x5.2) → (∀ x5 ∈ [(0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)), (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ))], ∀ (x7 : Finset ℕ), (∀ x8 ∈ x7, x8 < x1.size ∧ ((∃ (x10 : Bool), ∀ (x11 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x11 x5 = Bool.false → (x1.wires (List.ofFn x11)).getD ((9 : ℕ) + x8) Bool.false = x10) ∨ ∃ x10 < (9 : ℕ) + x8, ∀ (x11 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), x11 x5 = Bool.false → (x1.wires (List.ofFn x11)).getD ((9 : ℕ) + x8) Bool.false = (x1.wires (List.ofFn x11)).getD x10 Bool.false)) → x7.card ≤ (3 : ℕ)) → (16 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Petersen graph minus a vertex as in the parent, F its edge function: an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit computing F whose first gate (wire 9) is x0 OR x1, in which for each v among 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 at most 3 gates become constant or equal to an earlier wire when x_v is fixed false, has at least 16 gates.
